tasks.summary: Mapped the Laravel shortener into API, public redirect, core logic, data, Redis, and MySQL, with flows for creating and following links. The map is ready to browse locally.

items.note: Grouped as the signed-in API: login and link management sit here so the board starts where owners work.
Separated the public short-code jump from the API so the main visitor path is easy to see.
Highlighted as the Redis redirect cache—the newest product piece (phase 4) that speeds up public jumps.
This is the lookup step between the public redirect and the cache or database.
Creates short links with unique codes; central to the create-link flow on the map.
Public front door for GET /{code}; the map’s follow-link flow starts and ends here.
Lists every signed-in request; useful when reading the API side of the board.
Holds short-code drawing and Redis cache helpers that both create and redirect depend on.
Shown as an outside service because redirect lookups store payloads here.
Shown as the lasting store for users, links, and clicks.
